text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Slipped Capital Femoral Epiphysis (SCFE). The clinical presentation of a limp, knee pain in an otherwise healthy child, combined with the pelvic X-ray request, strongly points to this condition which requires immediate orthopedic evaluation.
